{{External|rs|rsc=Diamond Amulet of power}} {{Infobox Item |name = Amulet of power |image = [[File:Amulet of power.png]] |release = [[24 May]] [[2001]] |update = New magic system online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = An enchanted diamond amulet of power. |value = 3525 |weight = 0.010 |exchange = Yes |id = 1731 }} [[File:Amulet of power detail.png|left|140px]] An '''amulet of power''' offers a good balance of attack and defence bonuses for all classes of [[combat]]. It is created by casting [[Lvl-4 Enchant]] on a [[diamond amulet]], and has no requirements to be worn. This item is a less expensive option for players who do not wish to buy an [[amulet of glory]]. It lacks the glory's teleportation capabilities and has weaker [[Attack bonus|attack]] and [[Prayer bonus]]es, but has the same [[Strength bonus|strength]] bonus as well as higher [[defence bonus]]es. This amulet is currently the best overall amulet for F2P players, although the [[amulet of strength]] is better in some cases, such as fighting low defence targets with melee. A helpful way for P2P Ironmen to obtain one is by looting the [[H.A.M. Store room]]s for a diamond amulet, and then enchanting it with 57 [[Magic]]. [[Salvage|Shipwreck Salvaging]] at [[Mercenary shipwreck|Mercenary shipwrecks]] (73 [[Sailing]]) also commonly provides them. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = +6 |aslash = +6 |acrush = +6 |amagic = +6 |arange = +6 |dstab = +6 |dslash = +6 |dcrush = +6 |dmagic = +6 |drange = +6 |str = +6 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = +1 |slot = neck |image = [[File:Diamond amulet equipped.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Amulet of power equipped female.png|130px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Magic |skill1lvl = 57 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 67 |members = No |ticks = 1 |ticksnote = Manual casting is 3 ticks, auto-casting is 7 ticks |mat1 = Diamond amulet |mat2 = Cosmic rune |mat3 = Earth rune |mat3quantity = 10 |output1 = Amulet of power }} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Amulet of power}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Amulet of power}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Amulet of power}} ==Changes== ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Amulet of power detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Amulet of power detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Amulet of power (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Amulet of power.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
